content.title: Status filter dropdown shows raw status values instead of labels
content.description:
Cosmetic UI defect found while validating URL-driven dashboard filtering (mqguhe7eyw).

The Status filter dropdown trigger (components/issues/IssueFilters.tsx) renders the RAW status value (e.g. 'closed', 'in-progress', 'todo') instead of the human-readable label ('Closed', 'In Progress', 'Todo'). The option labels are correctly defined in STATUS_OPTIONS but the trigger does not map the selected value back to its label.

Root cause: the Select uses @base-ui/react Select.Value without a children render function, so it displays the raw value. Confirmed via E2E: the trigger text for /?status=closed is 'closed' not 'Closed'.

Suggested fix: pass a render/matcher to SelectValue that maps the current value to its STATUS_OPTIONS label, or restructure so the trigger shows the label.

Impact: cosmetic only; filtering behavior is correct. Out of scope for the URL-filtering validation task, so reporting separately for triage.
